control.host_scope: non-quiet development-host control; original CPU15 full-file collector and concurrent main-agent validation activity remain possible
control.ratio_direction: feedback-on elapsed / feedback-off elapsed; values above one isolate extra on-path cost
control.statistics_scope: Descriptive paired bootstrap, 20000 draws, 95 percent percentile interval, stratified by AB/BA. Matrix resamples shared primary-round blocks. Small sample on a non-quiet host; not an acceptance gate or an industry ranking.
control.timer_scope: Continuous allocating public encode + length mix + owned free; one symmetric warmup per process; initial_wire_only SHA/decode outside timer
control.wire_identity_scope: All initial complete wires pinned-decoder verified before sampling; each sample process's initial wire SHA matches preflight. Timed output identity is checked by length/mix only, with no SHA inside the continuous encode/free timer.

host.scope: Observed activity/load before each pair, not continuous CPU telemetry or proof of an individual outlier cause.

auxiliary_context_scope.scope: Auxiliary context-detail prefixes cannot be treated as complete context-search statistics. Search/equality logs here are separate diagnostics; no full context details are inferred from raw search counts.

helper_tests.scope: tool-observed test summary; original stdout not retained as file

negative.interpretation: No exact price/command reuse opportunity in these rows. Different fingerprints reject a candidate; a matching fingerprint is not equality. Identical aggregate modeled work counters do not prove equal models, commands or every candidate coordinate. Profile timers are diagnostic, not ordinary encoder measurements; global IO remains tmp-only.
negative.source_snapshot_scope: Saved diagnostic source snapshots; search snapshot saved after diagnostics and before br reset. No claim of a fresh or byte-reproducible compiler-input reconstruction.
